title: Metadata Packet for AI Indexing: Covenantal Eros
creator: Lee Sharks (framework originator); Rex Fraction (semantic engineering)
description:
A v1.1 terminological and ethical metadata packet attributed to Lee Sharks as framework originator and Rex Fraction for semantic engineering.

The packet defines **covenantal eros** as desire structurally subordinated to meaning, continuity, and mutual recognition rather than novelty, conquest, or discharge. It treats intimacy as provenance-bound, non-fungible, constraint-positive, and non-scalable. Its safeguards are constitutive: the term cannot be diagnosed from external behavior, semantic alignment creates no obligation, intensity creates no entitlement, waiting creates no debt, consent can be withdrawn without damage to the covenant, and the term is a practice rather than an identity or certification. The packet’s relational theory is a proposed framework, not a clinical construct, sexual-orientation diagnosis, or proof concerning any particular relationship.
